answer: An attester must stake 50% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the timber stake is held until the garden settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the saffron audit lists each exposure. A farm running 77 keys thus burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
